WebGPU widget discriminants + artifact registry — the

UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

GPU_WIDGET_KINDS

Widget kinds — one per animation domain migrated from a standalone WebGL canvas to a dedicated WebGPU wasm artifact on the widget's own canvas. Frozen; consumers import members, never redeclare literals.

BURGER

Nav burger hairline bars (fluid wave + breathing).

FLAG

Locale flag — wind warp + specular + split transition.

SWITCH_SLIDER

Preference toggle — pill track + per-context waveform.

THEME_SLIDER

Day/system/night slider — procedural sky scene.

CLOSE_BUTTON

Modal close — liquid fill + rotating X strokes.

MENU_BACKGROUND

Fullscreen menu backdrop — fbm contour field.

SKELETON

Loading skeleton — morphing 0/1 glyph cells.

BURN

Mosaic letter-burn — ember/char particle sim.

MEDIA

Media surface — decoded image/video textured quad.

GLITCH

About portrait — VHS glitch corruption passes.

DIVIDER_SHEEN

Footer divider — hairline + traveling sheen band.

TEXT_DRAW

Draw-text — instanced per-char writing animation.

RING_SHEEN

Mosaic/related tiles — instanced border ring sheen.

CORNER_BRACKETS

Action buttons — corner-bracket expansion.

SCENE3D

Full-scene surface — the scene3d engine handle (Surface3d). Not a uniform widget: mounts through core/utils/gpu/scene3d.ts, which reads its artifact spec from this same registry so the URL stays single-sourced here.

GENIE

Expand-modal genie — composited-sheet mesh-warp transition.

GPU_WIDGET_ARTIFACTS

Artifact registry — kind → wasm-pack glue URL + exported class name. url is /wasm/<slug>/<pkg>.js under public/; cls is the crate's #[wasm_bindgen] struct name (each crate exports a differently- named widget, so the bridge indexes the module dynamically). eager marks the skeleton — the only artifact allowed on the critical path since it IS the loading placeholder. Frozen; consumers import members, never redeclare literals.

GPU_WIDGET_DRIVE

Drive modes for mountWebGpuWidget — who owns the rAF clock. Frozen; consumers import members, never redeclare literals.

RAF

Bridge owns the rAF loop + resize listener — the default for stateless widgets (burger, flag, sliders, close, menu, media).

MANUAL

Caller owns the loop — for widgets whose host already runs a frame-scheduled loop with its own semantics (skeleton's frame-skip + resolve-out, burn's stage pump). The bridge skips rAF AND the resize listener entirely; the caller drives widget.frame(dt), widget.set_size(css), and widget.resize(device) through its existing paths so there is never a second clock or a second resize observer.
